## Technical walkthrough {#technical-walkthrough data-nav-title="Walkthrough"}

This view follows the paper and its reproducible R implementation step by step [@fry2024f1]. The research paper is joint work by **John Fry, Tom Brighton and Silvio Fanzon**; the website presentation and repository documentation are maintained by Silvio Fanzon [@f1repo].
